title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clear, deep soundboard recording (though a track is missing) of an average‑energy show that isn’t particularly standout.
ai_review.review: The audio quality is praised as one of the better versions available – clear, with good depth – but listeners note that a first‑set track is absent from the MP3 zip and the overall performance is only moderately played. The show lacks any highlighted jams or exceptional moments, resulting in a mixed listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers rate the recording positively (4 and 3 stars) highlighting good sound quality, while one flags missing files and another finds the performance only average; combined weighting yields a modest overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and deep with good detail; however, a first‑set track is missing from the MP3 zip and some listeners describe the sound as slightly distant.
